title: PixelStreaming Stream Config
description: Schema for PixelStreaming2 config keys used by the Unreal VTuber stack. Maps to values in pixel-streaming/config/*.ini.

Codec.description: Video codec for the PixelStreaming2 WebRTC stream. H264 is required for stable RTMP passthrough.

LatencyMode.description: Encoder latency mode. LowLatency allows periodic keyframes while keeping lag low; UltraLowLatency can suppress IDR frames and degrade quality over long sessions.

KeyframeInterval.description: Frames between forced IDR keyframes. 60 ~= 2s at 30fps, matching Twitch ingest guidance. Ensures decoders and RTMP pipelines can recover from drift.

H264Profile.description: H.264 encoding profile. Baseline provides the broadest decoder compatibility.

WebRTCNegotiateCodecs.description: When true, PixelStreaming2 negotiates codec preferences with the peer. CodecPreferences constrains the negotiation result.

TargetBitrate.description: Target encoder bitrate in bits/s. Set via PixelStreaming.Encoder.TargetBitrate console variable.

MaxBitrate.description: Maximum encoder bitrate in bits/s. Caps the encoder ceiling for CBR mode.

MinQP.description: Minimum quantization parameter (lower = higher quality). Controls the quality floor.

MaxQP.description: Maximum quantization parameter (higher = more compression). Controls the quality ceiling.

ResolutionSizeX.description: Horizontal render resolution in pixels. Set in GameUserSettings.ini.

ResolutionSizeY.description: Vertical render resolution in pixels. Set in GameUserSettings.ini.

MaxFPS.description: Maximum framerate cap via t.MaxFPS console variable.
